seo.title: AnyPress: managed WordPress, set up and looked after for you
seo.description: Managed WordPress for shops, studios, clubs and small businesses: a website, bookings, a shop or courses, ready to use. From [anypress_price type="website" size="small" period="monthly"] a month, no cut of sales.

seo.title: Prices for managed WordPress sites · AnyPress
seo.description: One monthly price per WordPress site, from [anypress_price type="website" size="small" period="monthly"], set by what you're building and how big it is. Hosting, email, backups and security included. No cut of your sales.

mainEntity.name: Why does a shop cost more than a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shops, bookings and members' areas do more work and send more email, so they need more from the computers they run on. The price follows what the site needs.

mainEntity.name: Which size do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with Small. It suits most new sites. If your site gets busy, move up to Medium or Large and nothing about your site changes except the room it has.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I send more email than my size includes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your everyday emails, like receipts and booking confirmations, keep sending. Newsletters to your list pause until the next month or until you move up a size.

mainEntity.name: Is there a yearly price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paying yearly costs 10 times the monthly price, so you get 2 months free.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a fee on sales?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The card company charges its normal fee on payments, and we add nothing on top.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your first website plan starts with 7 days free. You add a card when you start, and the plan's price starts on day 8 unless you cancel first. It's one free trial per person.

mainEntity.name: How do I cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: From your account, any time. Cancel in the first 7 days and you pay nothing. Within 30 days of your first payment, you get that payment back.

mainEntity.name: Can you make changes to my site for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Care gives your website time for changes each month, from [anypress_care item="care" show="monthly"] a month, and one-time help to set it up or move it in. See the care page at anypress.io/care.

seo.title: Sell websites · AnyPress
seo.description: Build a website once and sell it every month, under your own name. Every order on your storefront becomes the client's own site in minutes, and we host and look after every one.

seo.title: Become a reseller · AnyPress
seo.description: Sell websites under several brands from one login, at [anypress_number of="wholesalePercent"]% off every site, on one monthly bill. We host and look after every site.

seo.title: Who AnyPress is for · AnyPress
seo.description: Shops, educators, chambers, churches, franchises, web designers and software teams all build on AnyPress. See who it's for, what it fixes and which site fits.

seo.title: Websites for online shops & niche sellers · AnyPress
seo.description: Products, downloads, merch or subscriptions. Your shop arrives ready to sell, on your own domain, and you keep every sale.

mainEntity.name: Can I sell digital things, like music or downloads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sell downloads, physical products, subscriptions and gift codes from the same shop.

mainEntity.name: I already sell somewhere else. Can I move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Start your AnyPress shop next to your old one, add your products, then point your domain at it when you're ready.

mainEntity.name: What if I want a second shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each shop is its own site with its own plan. Three or more sites cost less each.

seo.title: Websites for supplements, CBD & other regulated products · AnyPress
seo.description: Your own store on your own domain, using the payment provider you're approved with. No platform rules about what you can list, and no cut of your sales.

mainEntity.name: Do you approve my products?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your payment provider decides what you can sell through them. We give you the store; you stay responsible for following the rules for your products.

mainEntity.name: Can I sell subscriptions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Monthly refills and subscribe-and-save work out of the box.

mainEntity.name: Is there a fee per order?

acceptedAnswer.text: No AnyPress fee. Your payment provider's fee is the only one.

seo.title: Websites for local services & trades · AnyPress
seo.description: We set up a website that shows up when people nearby search for what you do, lets them book a time, and keeps every customer in one list. You stay on the job.

mainEntity.name: Can you move my domain over?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Type in the domain you already have. With supported domain companies it connects in one click, and email can come from it too.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to edit the site myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only your words and photos, and only if you want to. If you can write an email, you can edit your pages. We do the technical part.

mainEntity.name: Can customers pay a deposit when they book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can take card payment when someone books, so a no-show doesn't cost you the slot.

mainEntity.name: Can it send my leads to HighLevel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AnyPress works with HighLevel, so the people who book or write in can land in your HighLevel contacts too.

seo.title: Websites for course creators & educators · AnyPress
seo.description: Sell programs, run classes and host your students' discussions on your own domain, for one monthly price.

mainEntity.name: Can I charge monthly for a membership?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sell courses as one-off purchases, memberships every month, or both.

mainEntity.name: Can I add live classes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With the Everything plan, students can book live sessions on the same site.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I have more students?

acceptedAnswer.text: Move up a size whenever you need to. Your site, courses and students stay where they are.

seo.title: Websites for chambers & associations · AnyPress
seo.description: A website for your organisation that collects dues, sells event tickets and gives members a place to connect.

mainEntity.name: Can our members get websites too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can offer your members their own AnyPress sites, under your name, as a member benefit or an income stream.

mainEntity.name: Do we need someone technical?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We set it up and look after it. Your team edits pages and members like any other website.

mainEntity.name: Is this for churches and ministries too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. See the page for churches.

seo.title: Websites for churches & ministries · AnyPress
seo.description: A website for your church that takes online giving, shares what's happening and gives your groups a place to connect.

mainEntity.name: Does it take a cut of giving?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only the card company's fee applies.

mainEntity.name: Can small groups talk on the site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With the Community or Everything plan, groups get their own space for news and discussion.

mainEntity.name: Can we stream services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can add your livestream or recordings to any page.

seo.title: Websites for franchises & multi-location brands · AnyPress
seo.description: Every location gets its own site from your starting point, with its own bookings and domain, and your brand stays the same everywhere.

mainEntity.name: Can each location have its own domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each site can use its own domain, or a page on yours.

mainEntity.name: Who pays: head office or the location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Either. Head office can pay for every site, or each location can buy its own.

mainEntity.name: Can we sell sites to our franchisees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Head office can become a seller and offer sites under your own brand.

seo.title: Selling websites on autopilot · AnyPress
seo.description: From the order to the day a client leaves: every site is built, billed, paused, backed up and taken offline on its own, so you never press a button.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to do anything when someone buys?

mainEntity.name: Can a client leave and come back?

mainEntity.name: Can I take a client's site somewhere else?

mainEntity.name: Can sites start somewhere other than my storefront?

seo.title: How getting a website on AnyPress works · AnyPress
seo.description: Pick what you're building and add a card, and your website is ready in minutes, with the first 7 days free. Add your words and photos, and we look after it every day from then on.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be technical?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We do the technical part. If you can write an email, you can edit your pages, and we're an email away if you get stuck.

mainEntity.name: How long does a new site take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minutes, not days. You get an email as soon as it's ready. If a build ever fails, we're told straight away and fix it.

mainEntity.name: Is my site really separate from everyone else's?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It has its own space and its own WordPress. Another site getting busy or having a problem doesn't touch yours.

mainEntity.name: Who can see or change my site?

acceptedAnswer.text: You, and anyone you add. We only step in to keep it running, or when you ask us for help.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring the site I already have?

acceptedAnswer.text: If it's on WordPress, yes. How moving works.

mainEntity.name: Can I take my site with me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It's real WordPress, so a full copy can go with you to any host. No lock-in.

seo.title: How selling websites on AnyPress works · AnyPress
seo.description: Your storefront takes the orders under your own name, every order becomes its own WordPress site built from your starting site, and AnyPress hosts and looks after every one.

mainEntity.name: Do my clients see AnyPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They buy from your storefront, get emails from your name and manage their site from an account on your shop.

mainEntity.name: What is a starting site?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's the site every new order is copied from. Use one of ours, or set up your own with your design, pages and plugins, so every client starts with it.

mainEntity.name: What does the storefront cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing. Your first storefront is included. You pay per site you sell.

mainEntity.name: Can I create sites without a shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sites can come from a form, a payment or your own app through the API, n8n, Make or Zapier. Create sites automatically.

mainEntity.name: Who supports my clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do the client-facing side. We support you, and we look after the sites themselves.

mainEntity.name: Who updates WordPress and the plugins?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do, for WordPress, our theme and the plugins we include. Every new release is tried on every kind of site before it reaches yours. Plugins you add yourself, you update in a new version of your starting site.

mainEntity.name: Does every site get the padlock (HTTPS)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every site and every domain your clients connect gets a free certificate, renewed for you.

mainEntity.name: What happens when a client stops paying?

acceptedAnswer.text: When their plan is cancelled, the site is backed up and taken offline for you. Nothing to remember.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring sites I already host?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose Move a site in on your dashboard and the whole site is copied across. How moving works.

seo.title: Join the AnyPress beta · AnyPress
seo.description: Finished WordPress sites built on the Fluent plugins: only the plugins you need, set up and connected, hosting and email handled, your old site moved in, and every site in one dashboard. Beta invites are open now.

seo.title: Run AnyPress yourself · AnyPress
seo.description: Run AnyPress on a server you choose: free to do yourself, or we set it up and look after it. For businesses that sell websites and companies that keep their sites on their own servers.

seo.title: Care for your website · AnyPress
seo.description: Monthly time for changes to your AnyPress website, requests answered by email, and one-time help to set up or move in your site.

seo.title: Help with your AnyPress website · AnyPress
seo.description: How to sign in, open your site's WordPress editor, use your own domain, cancel a plan, and get a refund on AnyPress.

mainEntity.name: How do I sign in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to your account page and sign in with the email address you bought your plan with. If you don't know your password, choose "Lost your password?" on the sign-in page and we'll email you a link to set a new one.

mainEntity.name: How do I open my site's editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sign in to your account page, open My website and choose Log in to your website. It opens your site's WordPress dashboard already signed in, with no second password.

mainEntity.name: My site isn't ready yet. Is that normal?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new site is usually ready a few minutes after you pay. We email you when it is. If it's been more than an hour, email us and we'll look right away.

mainEntity.name: What address does my site start with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every site starts on a free address ending in anypress.site, with a secure (https) connection. You can keep it or switch to your own domain whenever you like.

mainEntity.name: How do I use my own domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sign in to your account page and open My website. Under "Use your own domain" you'll find the records to add where your domain is managed (the company you bought it from, or Cloudflare). Add them, then type your domain in the same place. The secure connection is set up for you, and the old address keeps working for a few minutes while it switches.

mainEntity.name: How do I cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sign in to your account page, open My website and choose Manage or cancel plan. Your site stays online until the end of the period you've paid for, and you won't be charged again.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your first website plan starts with 7 days free. You add a card when you start, and the plan's price starts on day 8 unless you cancel first from your account. It's one free trial per person.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a refund?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your first payment for a new plan is covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. Email support@anypress.io within 30 days with your account's email address and your site name. A refund ends the plan and takes the site offline, so export anything you want to keep first. The details are in our refund policy.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my plan or size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Email us with your site name and what you'd like, and we'll switch it for you. The new price starts from your next renewal.

mainEntity.name: Is my site backed up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We save a copy of every site each night and keep daily and weekly copies. If something goes wrong, email us and we'll bring it back.

mainEntity.name: Who looks after security fixes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. Security fixes for WordPress, its plugins and the server are applied for you, so you can get on with your business.

mainEntity.name: I sell websites. Where do I sign in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sellers and resellers sign in to the dashboard at app.anypress.io, not here. It has every client and site you sell. New to selling? See how selling works.

mainEntity.name: Where do my clients sign in?

acceptedAnswer.text: On your own storefront. They never get an AnyPress login, and they never see AnyPress.

seo.title: Hosting and safety · AnyPress
seo.description: Every AnyPress site runs on its own, with its own WordPress and database, a free padlock, nightly backups we test every day, and the speed settings already done.

mainEntity.name: Is my site on a shared server?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sites share the machine, not the site. Each one has its own WordPress, database and set amount of computing power and memory, so a busy neighbour can't slow yours down or reach your files.

mainEntity.name: What happens if a backup fails?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's tried again ten minutes later. If it still fails, it lands on our list to fix. Your site keeps running either way.

mainEntity.name: How big can uploads be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Up to 64 MB a file on most sites. Community and Everything sites take up to 512 MB, for the videos members post.

mainEntity.name: Do you keep my backups if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: When a site is removed, its backups are kept for another 90 days, so it can be brought back if you change your mind.

mainEntity.name: Can I install my own plugins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your site is real WordPress. We look after the plugins every site comes with; ones you add, you update. See what's included.

mainEntity.name: Who updates WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. How updates stay safe.

seo.title: Safe updates for every site · AnyPress
seo.description: We update WordPress, the theme and the included plugins for every site, after trying each update on every kind of site. Sellers change their own starting site in versions they can go back from.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to update anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not for WordPress, our theme, our blocks or the plugins every site comes with. We do those. Plugins you add yourself, you update in a new version of your starting site.

mainEntity.name: Will an update change my pages or orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Updates change the software, not what's in the site. Your pages, posts, orders, members and uploads stay as they are.

mainEntity.name: How fast do security fixes arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: We look for new releases every hour. A fix reaches sites as soon as it has passed the checks above, usually the same day.

mainEntity.name: What if an update breaks something?

acceptedAnswer.text: It shouldn't get that far, because every update is tried on every kind of site first. If it does, the site can go back to the version it was on, and every site also has nightly backups.

mainEntity.name: Can I stop my clients' sites from getting a change of mine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your changes only reach a site when you move it to the new version. Until then it stays on the one it has.

mainEntity.name: Can I turn on automatic plugin updates in WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no need for the plugins we include, because we update them for you. For more about how sites are run, see hosting and safety.
